executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the most strained areas. The Daily Check from 2026-08-13 reviewed eight timely relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with delay. For buyers, supply-security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
